name: Blisters on The Land
summary: Blisters on The Land is an Alliance quest offered by Rethiel the Greenwarden along the eastern ridges of the Wetlands. Sensing an unnatural sickness stirring the swamp, the lone bog beast warden tasks travelers with culling the diseased Fen Creepers that stalk the waterways. Putting these shambling plant horrors to rest is Rethiel's attempt to break the swamp's rising fever.

sections.title: A Festering Marshes
sections.body: From his grove amid the marshes, Rethiel the Greenwarden watches over the soggy expanse of the Wetlands. The marshes have never been gentle, but recently an unnatural sickness has begun to spread through the mire. Rethiel perceives this affliction as a growing fever in the earth itself, one that causes wild nature to warp into mindless, shambling monstrosities.

sections.title: Cleansing the Fen
sections.body: The primary symptom of this rot is the rise of Fen Creepers—decaying elemental masses of swamp vegetation that shamble along the waterways. Rethiel describes them as diseased blisters swelling upon the surface of the land. Because their tormented existence only spreads agitation through the marsh, the Greenwarden charges passing allies with destroying them so their tangled remnants can settle harmlessly back into the mud.

aliases: who gives blisters on the land
faq.answer: Rethiel the Greenwarden is a bog beast residing at the Greenwarden's Grove in the eastern Wetlands. He dedicates himself to tending the natural balance of the marshlands, seeking to soothe the land's afflictions and curb corrupted elemental growths.
Fen Creepers are hostile plant and bog elementals that wander the waterways of the Wetlands. They appear as hulking, shambling masses of animated vines, mud, and decaying marsh flora.

faq.q: Why does Rethiel want the Fen Creepers destroyed?
faq.answer: Rethiel views the Fen Creepers as fevered, diseased manifestations of the marsh's growing sickness. He believes that destroying them allows their form to dissolve and settle back into the earth, soothing the agitated land.

faq.q: What causes the festering in the Wetlands?
faq.answer: Rethiel admits he does not fully know what is causing the festering to grow within the Wetlands. He simply senses the land's weeping distress and treats the symptoms by calming elemental unrest wherever it surges.

faq.q: Where are Fen Creepers found in the Wetlands?
faq.answer: Fen Creepers roam along the damp waterways, muddy banks, and central channels crisscrossing the Wetlands, particularly near the deeper bogs west of the Greenwarden's Grove.

faq.q: Does this quest connect to other tasks for Rethiel?
faq.answer: Yes. Blisters on The Land follows Rethiel's concerns regarding the Mosshide gnolls burning the Wetlands' trees in Fire Taboo, serving as part of his ongoing efforts to protect the balance of the marsh.

angles.text: Rethiel's mission directly reflects the druidic duty to heal the natural world, purging agitated elemental blights so the earth can return to balance.
Finding a solitary bog beast warden allied with Stormwind in the Eastern Kingdoms shows that even the land's own spirits will seek help to nurture wounded land.
The Fen Creepers represent twisted manifestations of earth and water, making their destruction an act of pacifying discordant elemental spirits.
